text:
Case note: C.C. No. 1013/2023
Client: Harpreet Rajan (retired bank officer, Thiruvananthapuram)
Opposing party: Chatterjee Builders Pvt Ltd
Court: Thiruvananthapuram District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
Filed on: 22/04/2023
Claim amount: INR 6,76,00,000/-
Issue: consumer complaint. Possession of the flat is long overdue.
Advice given: Claim interest on the amount paid for every month of delay in possession.
Outcome: The commission directed the builder to pay interest for the delay.
Recommended next step: File for execution if the builder does not pay.
